requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, cancel, and reschedule appointments online.
Patients should be able to request repeat prescriptions online.
Patients should have secure access to their test results after clinician review.
System must effectively flag urgent cases for same-day appointments.
The portal must be user-friendly, especially for elderly patients and those less familiar with technology.
Patients should be able to see available time slots for appointments.
Patients should have the option to book appointments with either GPs or nurses.
The system must allow patients to reschedule or cancel appointments online.
GPs and nurses should be able to manage their availability directly in the system.
There should be an easy way for patients to indicate if they need a same-day appointment due to urgent symptoms.
Patients should be able to see a clear list of their current prescriptions.
The system should allow patients to request refills directly from their list of active prescriptions.
The system should send reminders to patients when they are due for a refill.
Prescription requests must be securely processed with safeguards in place to prevent unauthorized requests.
Patients should receive notifications when their test results are ready to be viewed.
Test results must be presented in a clear and understandable format, avoiding medical jargon.
There must be a secure login process for accessing test results, including a verification step.
All patient data must be encrypted and secure to comply with GDPR.
Patients should have a clear option to indicate they have urgent symptoms when booking an appointment.
Urgent cases should be routed to the reception team for immediate review.
The system should automatically prioritize urgent requests in the appointment scheduling view.
GPs and nurses should have a dedicated section in their calendars for managing urgent appointments.
Patients should receive communication throughout the process, including confirmation of their urgent appointment request.
